main_body: Sci-fi building: a sloped panelled metal roof, an orange eave strip, and a grey front wall with two cyan windows, two dark windows and a central door
top_band: In a middle column (x≈30): pale blue-grey roof slope from row 1 to row 17, with a lighter lower edge at rows 15-17
evidence: The roof is a large, clearly visible sloped top surface (rows 1-17) with vents and panel seams. A light edge at rows 16-17 and a dark row at 18 mark the front edge and eave shadow. The orange eave strip sits at rows 19-20. The wall face (rows 21-41) has windows with dark inset frames and a recessed door with a hazard-striped sill. Both the top surface and the front face are clearly drawn, so it reads as 3/4.

style.evidence: The roof is a handful of flat blue-grey panels separated by seam lines, with no per-tile scallops or grain like the Beodeul tile roofs. The wall has large flat grey areas, with only a few speckle pixels and panel seams. The windows and door have good detail, but the roof and wall areas run 5x5 or larger in one flat colour. Shading has about 4 steps against the references' 5-6, and the outline is partly near-black (top edge, window frames) and partly tinted. Overall it is thinner and flatter than the references.
